pieces.Text: An omox can use its grab ability against a creature of any size.  When it grabs a foe, it attempts to flow over and into the victim's mouth and nose to smother it.  Each round the omox maintains its grapple, its victim cannot breathe or speak.  See page 445 of the Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook for rules on how long a victim can hold its breath and the consequences of suffocation.
